title: Quick chat
description: profiles/<slug>/chats/<id>.json: a quick chat, a Claude conversation on a board that is not a ticket. Type QuickChat in src/chat/quickchat.ts; written by QuickChats.save (pretty JSON, 2-space indent, final newline, atomic temp+rename). Created (new chat or fork) with every required field. The conversation text is Claude Code's own session transcript, found by sessionId. Unknown fields must be kept.

id.description: Short base36 id (newId). Equals the file name without .json.

sessionId.description: Claude Code session id, a random UUID (a new one after a reset or a rewind that left nothing).

title.description: Set by Rename (or a fork's title); null: the title comes from the first message.

firstMessage.description: The first message the user sent; null until then (and in a fork that kept nothing).

updatedAt.description: When the last message was sent or the last reply ended.

started.description: Claude saved the conversation (Make ticket needs it).

ticketId.description: Make ticket turned this chat into this ticket: the chat continues there.

error.description: Why the last reply failed (cleared by the next message).

pending.description: Messages held while a restart was pending: the next start sends them.

interrupted.description: A reply a restart cut off: recover() continues it. prompt: Claude never got the message, so it goes again.

frontDesk.description: The Telegram front desk's chat (src/helper/frontdesk.ts); it never becomes a ticket.

rewindUndo.description: RewindUndo (src/chat/rewind.ts): what the last Rewind changed, so Undo can put it back.

sessionId.description: The session the rewind cut; its file has a .before-rewind copy beside it.

hash.description: sha1 (hex) of the session file right after the cut.

newSessionId.description: The cut left nothing, so the chat went on in this new session.
